correctness.rationale: Cut reduction is exact on each ordered coordinate cone because the support width of every simplex is linear in adjacent ordered gaps; strict norm subadditivity gives exactly the step-ray equality cases. Mixed hub-tube count is 2^m-2^(m-b). A fully analytical rational comparison proves f_n(b) strictly falls for b>=2 in the n>=14 range and proves the unique 14-to-15 crossing with exact inequalities. Checked norm, mirror b>n/2, small dimensions, and all boundary cases. Extracted checker confirms 1154 direct support tests and 90983 exact cut checks, but finite checks do not establish the theorem.

value.rationale: Minimum width is a natural exact geometric invariant of the standard stellohedron. The result exhausts every dimension and minimizing direction, and identifies a genuinely discrete geometric transition at fourteen leaves between m single-leaf lines and exponentially many balanced-cut lines. The threshold is not forced by the known inball, circumball, mean-width or combinatorial data; it is not an arbitrary finite calculation or an unmotivated tiny improvement.
